positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: - Design and develop web-based systems built in .Net Core and AWS for inventory and sales management.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Promoted from Senior Software Engineer to Principal Software Engineer in January 2020.
- Responsible for coordinating the senior and dev-ops engineers to provide full stack solutions in
various business domains.
- Served as mentor to Software Engineers Level I and II, encouraging team members to advance
their development skills and align on team best practices and quality standards.
- Ability to quickly come up to speed in a multitude of legacy applications and domains to support
and maintain
● Developed and maintained custom solutions for Mura CMS framework.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed websites and backend infrastructure for the organization in Angular, ASP and ASP .Net.
- Created a custom plugins for DotNet Nuke CMS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Researched, Designed, Implemented and Maintained multiple Products, a variety of internal tools, and customizations for clients requiring tailored functionality. 
- Project details involve creation and maintenance of Data Models, Business Services, Reporting Services and User Interfaces, for use in reporting software for Drilling Contractors and Well Operating Companies. 
- Developed .NET (VB) software application using Visual Studio, SQL Server, Infragistics, ComponentOne, and Active Reports.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Planned, Designed, Built, Maintained two large database harvest projects. Project details involve extracting data from customer sites, automating transport it to our hosted environment and then extract those into a format desirable for external reporting agencies.
- Provided direct Customer Support, diagnosing bugs and user issues along with provide timely and appropriate solutions.
- Developed .NET (VB) software application using Visual Studio.
- Lead various customer integration projects. Consisted of modifying our application to meet any and all customer needs.

positions.title: Department Systems Specialist I
positions.description:
- Project Lead in charge of the development of a Time Management add-on to an existing work order and asset management system (Infor EAM).
- Intra/Internet Webmaster for the Department of General Services, Animal Care, and City Operator websites.
- Administrator for asset management and work order system used by the Department of General Services
- Experience with Visio Flowcharts, Crystal Reports, Business Objects and Access Databases.
- Point of contact for various project planning and implementation
- IT Help Desk
